description: Income tax and other government payments
coverage_notes:
[government-federal-state] 75 entries (75 detailed, 0 roster, 73 verified). Checked against the Federation of Tax Administrators list of state agencies: all 50 states + DC have one detailed entry (51). Federal (15): IRS balance due/Direct Pay, IRS payment plans, 1040-ES, EFTPS, SSA overpayment, Medicare CMS-500/IRMAA, RRB, VA copays, VA Debt Management Center, Treasury Offset, Cross-Servicing, Pay.gov, USPS PO Box, OPM Retirement Services annuitant debts, CMS BCRC conditional-payment recovery. Local income/earnings-tax collectors (9, a partial answer to the local-tax gap): RITA and CCA (Ohio municipal), Philadelphia Revenue, Berkheimer, Keystone Collections Group and Jordan Tax Service (PA local EIT/per capita), City of Detroit income tax (billed by Michigan Treasury, paid via Paymentus), St. Louis earnings tax (upgraded to detailed in review 2; paid via PayIt) and Kansas City MO earnings tax (added in review 2; retirees with only pension/Social Security income are exempt). Review 1 (2026-09-29) HTTP-checked every URL and content-checked about 30 entries. Review 2 (2026-09-29): re-ran an HTTP check on all 371 URLs (337 returned 200; 9 were portal 302 login redirects; 24 returned 403 bot-blocks on mass.gov, tax.ri.gov, revenue.nh.gov, ssa.gov, keystonecollects.com, kcmo.gov, aztaxes.gov and the IRS OLA login; the Kansas City Quick Tax portal did not respond; no 404s). Content was fetched for about 28 entries: IL, OH, NC, IN, GA, OR, AL, WI, MN, NJ, NY, TN, AR, DE, WY and MA (archive), IRS Direct Pay, Medicare premiums, EFTPS, USPS PO Box, and the 5 new or upgraded local entries. Review 2 filled autopay_cancel for IL, OH, NC, IN, GA, OR and AL, with the official page that explains cancelling a scheduled payment. It added senior property-tax relief programs for IL, TN, AR, DE, NC, OK, HI, LA and WY and a confirmed MA Senior Circuit Breaker URL. It also added the MN card processor (US Bank) and phone numbers for WY and NH. For the no-income-tax states (AK, FL, NV, NH, SD, TN, TX, WA, WY) the entry explains there is no state income-tax bill and points to senior property-tax relief.

[territories-utilities-gov] Checked against the territory rows of rosters/electric_utilities.csv (EIA-861: PREPA 1,511,847 customers; Guam Power Authority 53,559; VI WAPA 54,457; CNMI CUC 17,555; ASPA 12,684 - all five have detailed entries) and rosters/water_systems_large.csv (EPA SDWIS: every large PR system belongs to PRASA/AAA, Guam systems to GWA; CUC and ASPA provide water in CNMI/AS; WAPA provides potable water in the USVI), so every territory resident's electric and water biller is covered. Electric in PR: LUMA Energy bills all PREPA/AEE customers; Genera PR (New Fortress) only operates PREPA's legacy power plants and does not bill customers, so it has no entry. Behind-the-meter solar lessors in PR/GU/VI on EIA (Sunnova ~54k PR customers, Sunrun ~28k PR) bill separately for solar leases/PPAs but are out of scope here. Government: PR property tax (CRIM), PR income tax (Hacienda/SURI), PR marbete/driver services (CESCO/DTOP), Guam DRT income tax and real property tax (PayGuam), Guam vehicle registration renewal (MyGuamTax; the reviewer corrected an earlier pointer to myid.guam.gov, which is the driver's-license/ID portal), USVI BIR income tax, USVI Tax Collector property tax, USVI BMV, CNMI Division of Revenue and Taxation, American Samoa Tax Office. Propane: Tropigas and Empire Gas (PR) are detailed here and also appear as roster entries in propane-heating-oil.json. Not duplicated here because they exist elsewhere: AutoExpreso (PR tolls, dmv-tolls-municipal.json), Liberty Puerto Rico and Claro Puerto Rico (cable/internet/landline/wireless files), Triple-S and MCS (medicare-health-insurance.json); also already elsewhere: Viya and GTA/Teleguam, IT&E (CNMI), Bluesky (AS), Banco Popular/FirstBank PR, PR public housing and ASUME. Trash: Puerto Rico municipalities generally fund residential trash collection from municipal revenue (CRIM/IVU) and do not send separate household trash bills; USVI and CNMI likewise have no household trash bill found; ASPA bills solid waste on its combined utility bill; Guam Solid Waste Authority does bill about 20,000 curbside households monthly; the reviewer found its official site (gswa.guam.gov) and upgraded it to detailed. Limits this session: web search quota was exhausted partway through, so later research relied on direct fetches of official sites; several official pages render with JavaScript or refused automated fetch (GPA financial-assistance page 403, ADSEF site refused connection, guamtax.com contact page blank). Reviewer pass 2026-09-30: every URL in the file was status-checked with curl (all resolve; lumapr.com returns 403 and guamwaterworks.org returns 429 to curl, so those pages were re-read with a fetch tool). Page content was re-read for 25+ entries' links. Changes: GSWA upgraded from roster to detailed. Guam MVD entry corrected to the MyGuamTax renewal and verified. Guam DRT income-tax and RPT entries got phones, mailing address, the MyGuamTax 'How to pay your 1040' page and the Senior Citizen & Disability real property tax credit. CESCO URLs updated for the web.cescodigital.pr.gov redirect, and the marbete pay_bill now points to Hacienda's colecturía directory, which lists marbete renewal. AAA got its separate payment and correspondence PO boxes, CUC got a payment-arrangements link, and ASPA notes now cover the CashPower prepaid option. CNMI and American Samoa levy essentially no residential real property tax bill, so no property-tax entries exist for them. Web search was unavailable to the reviewer (quota exhausted), so new billers could be found only by probing official domains.

entries.name: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division (no individual income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: Alaska has no state individual income tax or statewide sales tax; seniors typically owe only local property/sales taxes (borough/city)
entries.mail_payment_address: Tax Division, Alaska Department of Revenue, P.O. Box 110420, Juneau, AK 99811-0420
entries.notes: Included for completeness: no individual income tax. Property tax bills are local (borough/municipality). Senior property tax exemption (first $150,000 assessed value, age 65+) is administered by local assessors, not the Tax Division.

entries.name: Alabama Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: Alabama individual income tax balances, billing letters/assessments, 40ES estimated payments
entries.phone_customer_service: 334-353-8096 (Taxpayer Assistance Group; also regional Taxpayer Service Centers listed on Help Center)
entries.mail_payment_address: Billing letters/assessments: mail to the address on the letter (per Income Tax Payment Options page)
entries.payment_processor: My Alabama Taxes (MAT, state portal) - ACH debit and credit/debit card
entries.senior_programs: Homestead exemptions for age 65+ (income-based: AGI under $12,000 exempt from all ad valorem taxes; otherwise state exemption plus $2,000 county assessed-value exemption); apply at county office: https://www.revenue.alabama.gov/property-tax/homestead-exemptions
entries.notes: Pay a Bill link on MAT requires the Letter ID and Account Number from the bill. Income tax payment options: https://www.revenue.alabama.gov/individual-corporate/income-tax-payment-options/ . EFT/ACH: https://www.revenue.alabama.gov/individual-corporate/pay-by-eft-ach/ . No state payment-plan how-to page found this pass; Taxpayer Advocacy page used as assistance link. Form 40ES vouchers for estimated tax. Review 2: autopay_cancel = ADOR FAQ (fetched): MAT EFT payments can be cancelled the same day by 4:00 p.m. CT while Pending (click request > Withdraw > Confirm).

entries.name: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration - Individual Income Tax
entries.service_area_detail: Arkansas individual income tax balances and estimated payments (AR1000ES)
entries.payment_processor: ATAP (Arkansas Taxpayer Access Point, state GenTax portal) for ACH; ACI Payments (officialpayments.com) for credit/debit card
entries.senior_programs: Homestead property tax credit and assessment freeze for homeowners 65+ or disabled (apply with county assessor): https://www.dfa.arkansas.gov/office/arkansas-assessment-coordination-division/real-property/property-tax-relief/
entries.notes: Credit card payments: https://www.dfa.arkansas.gov/office/taxes/income-tax-administration/individual-income-tax/credit-card-payments/ (ACI Payments, fee). ATAP lets users view payments submitted, recent account activity and correspondence, and store banking info. Payment vouchers: https://www.dfa.arkansas.gov/office/taxes/income-tax-administration/payment-vouchers/ . No online payment-plan page found this pass.

entries.name: American Samoa Government - Department of Treasury Tax Office
entries.service_area_detail: American Samoa territorial income tax (Form 390 filings); in-person filing season from late January.
entries.notes: Page provides Form 390 spreadsheets by year and filing-season hours (Mon-Fri 8am-3pm); no online payment option or mailing address listed.

entries.name: Arizona Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: Arizona individual income tax balances, 140ES estimated payments, payment arrangements
entries.mail_payment_address: Mail with Form AZ-140V payment voucher to the address on the form (https://azdor.gov/forms/payment-vouchers)
entries.payment_processor: AZTaxes.gov (state portal) - free e-check; credit/debit card (fee)
entries.senior_programs: Property Tax Refund (Credit) Claim, Form 140PTC (refundable credit for qualified low-income homeowners/renters; see form instructions for age 65+/income limits): https://azdor.gov/forms/tax-credits-forms/property-tax-refund-credit-claim-form-fillable
entries.notes: E-check payments can be scheduled for a later date and are free; scheduled e-payments can be canceled at AZTaxes "Cancel Payment" (Individual). Estimated payments due Apr 15, Jun 15, Sep 15, Jan 15. Payment plan request online at https://www.aztaxes.gov/Home/PaymentPlan (confirmation number and monthly amount given; may take up to 8 weeks if no bill yet). Paper payment info: https://azdor.gov/making-payments-late-payments-and-filing-extensions . Property Tax Refund Credit (Form 140PTC) for low-income seniors 65+ is claimed on the state return. Reviewer 2026-09-29: Cancel Individual Income Payment page (https://www.aztaxes.gov/Home/CancelPaymentIndividual/) cancels e-filed/AZTaxes payments until 5pm MST the business day before withdrawal; needs confirmation number, SSN, ZIP, tax year and amount.

entries.name: California Franchise Tax Board (FTB) - personal income tax
entries.service_area_detail: California personal income tax balances, bills/notices, Form 540-ES estimated payments, payment plans
entries.phone_customer_service: Payment plans 800-689-4776; manage/skip plan payment 888-635-0494 (general line not captured in fetched text)
entries.mail_payment_address: Estimated payments: Franchise Tax Board, PO Box 942867, Sacramento CA 94267-0008 (with Form 540-ES voucher; check payable to "Franchise Tax Board")
entries.payment_processor: FTB Web Pay (free bank debit, state); ACI Payments (officialpayments.com) for credit card; FTB mobile app
entries.senior_programs: Senior Citizens' Property Tax Postponement is run by the State Controller (not FTB). FTB Taxpayer Advocate: https://www.ftb.ca.gov/help/disagree-or-resolve-an-issue/taxpayer-advocate-services.html
entries.notes: Web Pay (https://www.ftb.ca.gov/pay/bank-account/index.asp) can schedule payments up to one year ahead; cancel a Web Pay request up to 2 business days before the scheduled date (help page). MyFTB account shows balance, lets you view/cancel/schedule payments. Credit card: https://www.ftb.ca.gov/pay/credit-card.html . Estimated tax: https://www.ftb.ca.gov/pay/estimated-tax-payments.html . If you cannot pay: https://www.ftb.ca.gov/pay/if-you-cant-pay/index.html . Payment plans have automatic monthly bank withdrawal option; manage online. Reviewer 2026-09-29: FTB credit card page (https://www.ftb.ca.gov/pay/credit-card.html) says pay online or call 800-272-9829 with ACI Payments (2.3% fee).

entries.name: Colorado Department of Revenue - Taxation (individual income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: Colorado individual income tax bills, estimated payments, payment plans
entries.payment_processor: Revenue Online (state) - credit/debit card or e-check, no login required; EFT; check; cash
entries.senior_programs: PTC Rebate (Property Tax/Rent/Heat Rebate for seniors 65+, surviving spouses, disabled) - linked from Individual Income Tax menu on tax.colorado.gov
entries.notes: Pay Tax Bill page lists card/e-check, check, EFT, cash methods. Payment Options by tax type: https://tax.colorado.gov/payment-options . Estimated payments page explains Revenue Online and EFT (EFT requires advance registration). Payment plans: https://tax.colorado.gov/payment-plan . Citizens advocate: https://tax.colorado.gov/citizens-advocate .

entries.name: Connecticut Department of Revenue Services (DRS) - individual income tax
entries.service_area_detail: Connecticut income tax balances, CT-1040ES estimated payments
entries.payment_processor: myconneCT (state portal, ACH debit/direct payment); credit/debit card via card service provider (convenience fee)
entries.senior_programs: Renters' Rebate Program for elderly (65+) and disabled renters (CT OPM): https://portal.ct.gov/opm/igpp/grants/tax-relief-grants/renters--rebate-for-elderly-disabled-renters-tax-relief-program
entries.notes: Tax Information page (Payment Options and Estimated Tax Payments sections) explains ACH debit and card payments via myconneCT; 2026 estimated due Apr 15, Jun 15, Sep 15, Jan 15 2027. myconneCT FAQ: https://portal.ct.gov/drs/myconnect/myconnect-2/faq . Payment plan page not located (portal.ct.gov largely client-rendered). Page content confirmed via WebFetch.

entries.name: DC Office of Tax and Revenue (OTR) - individual income tax
entries.service_area_detail: District of Columbia individual income tax (D-40) balances, estimated payments (D-40ES), installment agreements; also real property tax
entries.mail_payment_address: Check/money order payable to "DC Treasurer" with TIN, phone and tax year; mailing address per form
entries.payment_processor: MyTax.DC.gov (state portal): ACH debit free; credit/debit card 2.25% convenience fee
entries.senior_programs: Taxpayer Advocate: https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/taxpayer-advocate ; real property tax payment/billing: https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/real-property-payments-billing
entries.notes: Installment agreements are set up in MyTax.DC.gov with mandatory automatic ACH debit (bank info required) - effectively autopay; generally <=24 months and balance < $100,000. Estimated tax interest rules: https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/underpayment-estimated-tax-interest .

entries.name: Delaware Division of Revenue - personal income tax
entries.service_area_detail: Delaware personal income tax balances, delinquent bills, quarterly estimated tax
entries.phone_customer_service: 302-577-8200 (Personal Income Tax Assistance); Collections/Account Management 302-577-8785; Installments 302-577-8586
entries.senior_programs: Senior School Property Tax Credit (65+, 50% of school property tax on primary residence, capped; apply by April 30): https://finance.delaware.gov/senior-relief/
entries.notes: Payment page links individuals to pay current return balance or delinquent bill, and quarterly estimated tax, all on the Delaware Taxpayer Portal. Installment agreements handled by phone (302-577-8586). Individual Taxpayer Services hub: https://revenue.delaware.gov/individual-taxpayer-services/ .

entries.name: Florida Department of Revenue (no personal income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: No personal income tax; property tax info only
entries.senior_programs: Homestead exemption and additional senior (65+, limited income) homestead exemptions - applied for with the county property appraiser.
entries.notes: No state personal income tax. Seniors' main state/local tax bill is the property tax, billed and collected by the county tax collector (not DOR). Included so Florida users see there is no state income tax bill. Exemptions page: https://floridarevenue.com/property/pages/Taxpayers_Exemptions.aspx .

entries.name: Georgia Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: Georgia individual income tax balances, assessment notices, 500-ES estimated payments, installment agreements
entries.payment_processor: Georgia Tax Center (GTC, state portal) - free bank debit, quick pay without login; credit card/PayPal via third-party processor (2.31% fee, $1 min)
entries.senior_programs: Senior homestead exemptions (65+: $4,000 county exemption with income limit; 62+: $10,000 school exemption and floating inflation-proof exemption); apply at county tax commissioner: https://dor.georgia.gov/property-tax-homestead-exemptions
entries.notes: Electronic payments can be set up to occur on or before the due date (scheduled). Quick payment: https://dor.georgia.gov/make-quick-payment . Payment FAQ: https://dor.georgia.gov/make-payment-faq . Installment Agreement Request (GA-9465): https://dor.georgia.gov/ga-9465-installment-agreement-request ; payment plan default letter explains cancellation: https://dor.georgia.gov/payment-plan-default-letter . If bank account on a payment plan changes, call Income Tax Collection 404-417-2122. Property tax/homestead exemptions (senior) are county-administered. Reviewer 2026-09-29: Payment Options page (fetched): card/PayPal fee 2.31% ($1 min); credit card payments cannot be canceled once submitted; payment plans via GTC or Form GA-9465; no pay-by-phone line listed. Review 2: autopay_cancel = Make A Payment FAQ (fetched): ePayments must be cancelled before 3:00 pm ET on the payment date; credit card payments cannot be cancelled.

entries.name: Guam Department of Revenue and Taxation (DRT) - income tax payments (PayGuam)
entries.service_area_detail: Guam territorial income tax (Guam files instead of the IRS), gross receipts tax and other GovGuam tax bills, paid to the Treasurer of Guam.
entries.mail_payment_address: Dept. of Revenue & Taxation, Taxpayer Services Division, P.O. Box 23607, Barrigada, GU 96921 (general mailing address from the contact page; walk-in 1240 Army Drive, Barrigada)
entries.payment_processor: PayGuam (pay.guam.gov, Government of Guam portal built by Data Management Resources / PacificOne; Visa, MasterCard, Discover, AmEx; registration required)
entries.senior_programs: Guam offers Form 1040-SR (Guam tax return for seniors) on its forms page (https://www.guamtax.com/forms/index.html). No senior payment program found.
entries.notes: Reviewer 2026-09-30: guamtax.com/help/contact.html is a meta-refresh to /app/contactus.do, which lists phones, the P.O. Box 23607 mailing address and the Barrigada office; phones and mail address are filled from it. MyGuamTax 'How to Pay Your 1040' (now pay_bill) walks through paying on Pay.Guam.gov: register, choose 'Income Tax returns', enter the e-filing confirmation details, check out (card only). PayGuam FAQ (https://pay.guam.gov/pg/FAQs.aspx): Visa, MasterCard, Discover, AmEx; PIN-based debit not accepted; income tax/GRT payments need a PIN requested inside PayGuam; 3.50% convenience fee on tax payments since Oct 1, 2024; partial payments allowed; you can pay someone else's bill with their account number and PIN; 'FAST PAY' saves recurring payment details (not automatic payment). Payments list: https://pay.guam.gov/pg/payments.aspx . MyGuamTax individual online services: https://www.myguamtax.com .

entries.service_area_detail: Illinois individual income tax balances, IL-1040-ES estimated payments, installment payment plans

entries.name: Departamento de Hacienda de Puerto Rico - SURI (income tax payments)
entries.parent_company: Government of Puerto Rico - Departamento de Hacienda (Puerto Rico Treasury)
entries.service_area_detail: Puerto Rico individual income tax (planilla de contribución sobre ingresos), balances due, estimated tax, and other Hacienda debts; filed and paid through SURI (Sistema Unificado de Rentas Internas).
entries.mail_payment_address: Departamento de Hacienda, P.O. Box 9024140, San Juan, PR 00902-4140
entries.payment_processor: in-house SURI and Colecturía Virtual; Colecturía Digital (https://www.colecturiadigital.com/Public/Login.aspx) for stamps/vouchers; cash or card at colecturías
entries.senior_programs: Payment plans: debts up to $50,000 can be set up online in SURI (Más Opciones > Solicitudes > Solicitar un plan de pago) with no documents; any amount by calling Hacienda Responde or visiting a Distrito de Cobro. Offer-in-compromise and payroll-deduction plans also listed. No senior-specific payment program found.
entries.notes: Spanish only. Pagos page (https://hacienda.pr.gov/pagos) summarizes paying online through SURI and Colecturía Virtual, colecturías, service centers, and the mail address; methods detail at https://hacienda.pr.gov/pagos/metodos-de-pago and FAQ at https://hacienda.pr.gov/pagos/preguntas-frecuentes . Puerto Rico residents generally file with Hacienda instead of (or in addition to) the IRS. Account/payment history is inside SURI (login required); no public how-to page found for it. The collection office directory is linked from the Servicios al Contribuyente page. Reviewer 2026-09-30: site footer confirms 'Para pagos llama al (787) 620-2323, Opción 2' and PO Box 9024140. Colecturía directory: https://hacienda.pr.gov/sobre-hacienda/servicios-al-contribuyente/directorio-de-colecturias .

entries.name: Rhode Island Division of Taxation - personal income tax

entries.payment_processor: RI Tax Portal (state, ACH same-day or future-dated); credit card via RI Interactive at https://www.ri.gov/app/taxation/payments (2% + $2 fee)
entries.senior_programs: Property tax relief credit (Form RI-1040H) for low-income homeowners/renters incl. 65+ - see https://tax.ri.gov/tax-sections/credits (not fetched this pass).
entries.notes: Tax Portal lets taxpayers view/print bills, view outstanding debts, view history of returns and payments and estimated/extension payments, and schedule future-dated payments. Installment agreements: request form (https://tax.ri.gov/sites/g/files/xkgbur541/files/2023-08/Installment%20Agreement_b._0.pdf, from search result, not fetched); generally half the balance down; monthly coupons mailed; pay coupons in the Tax Portal as 'Bill Payment' with the coupon invoice number. Division warns of text-message scams: it does not text taxpayers about balances. tax.ri.gov is behind a bot challenge; pages read via Internet Archive 2026 snapshots.

entries.name: EFTPS - Electronic Federal Tax Payment System
entries.parent_company: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
entries.service_area_detail: Free Treasury payment system for individuals and businesses (estimated taxes, balances due, employment taxes)
entries.notes: Enrollment takes up to 5 business days (PIN mailed). Schedule payments up to 365 days ahead; change or cancel scheduled payments; email notifications; payment history searchable online. Guides: Pub 966 https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p966.pdf. EFTPS page on irs.gov documents scheduling/cancel; eftps.gov is the login site.

entries.name: IRS - Federal individual income tax balance due (Direct Pay / Online Account)
entries.service_area_detail: All U.S. taxpayers; balances due on Form 1040, IRS notices (CP14 etc.), amended returns, extensions
entries.phone_pay_by_phone: Card payments by phone via IRS-approved processors (see pay-by-card page); EFTPS voice response 800-555-3453 for enrolled users
entries.mail_payment_address: Check/money order payable to "U.S. Treasury"; mailing address depends on state and form - see https://www.irs.gov/filing/where-to-file-paper-tax-returns-with-or-without-a-payment
entries.payment_processor: IRS Direct Pay / Online Account (Treasury, free ACH); cards via Pay1040 and ACI Payments (fees apply); cash via retail partners (ACI Payments / Pay1040 barcode)
entries.senior_programs: Tax Counseling for the Elderly (TCE, free tax help age 60+): https://www.irs.gov/individuals/tax-counseling-for-the-elderly ; Seniors & retirees hub: https://www.irs.gov/individuals/seniors-retirees ; Taxpayer Advocate Service: https://www.taxpayeradvocate.irs.gov/ ; Offer in Compromise: https://www.irs.gov/payments/offer-in-compromise ; Temporarily delay collection (hardship/CNC): https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/temporarily-delay-the-collection-process
entries.notes: Online Account (sa.www4.irs.gov/ola) shows balance due, payment history (pending, scheduled, canceled, returned, processed) and notices; payments can be scheduled up to 365 days ahead. Direct Pay (https://directpay.irs.gov/directpay/payment) needs no sign-in; one payment at a time (no recurring); scheduled payments can be changed/canceled up to 2 business days before using the confirmation number. There is no ongoing autopay for a one-time balance; recurring automatic payment exists only via a Direct Debit Installment Agreement (see IRS payment plan entry) or EFTPS scheduling. Card: https://www.irs.gov/payments/pay-your-taxes-by-debit-or-credit-card (to cancel a card payment contact the card processor). Check/money order: https://www.irs.gov/payments/pay-by-check-or-money-order. Cash: https://www.irs.gov/payments/pay-your-taxes-with-cash. Transcripts (account transcript = proof of payments posted): https://www.irs.gov/individuals/get-transcript. Scam note: IRS never demands immediate payment by gift card/wire by phone. Reviewer 2026-09-29: IRS pay-by-card page (fetched) lists the two authorized card processors: Pay1040 (https://www.pay1040.com/payment/personal; debit $2.15, credit 1.75% min $2.50) and ACI Payments (https://fed.acipayonline.com/index.jsp; debit $2.10, credit 1.85% min $2.50). The page gives no processor phone numbers; card payments are canceled only through the processor.

entries.name: IRS - Payment Plan (Installment Agreement), incl. Direct Debit Installment Agreement
entries.service_area_detail: Monthly installment agreements and short-term (<=180 day) plans for federal tax owed
entries.payment_processor: IRS (Direct Debit from checking; or Direct Pay/EFTPS/card/check monthly)
entries.senior_programs: Low-income setup fee waiver/reduction (Form 13844 https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f13844.pdf); Simple payment plans; Taxpayer Advocate Service
entries.notes: Online Payment Agreement tool (Apply/Revise) lets you view plan type, due dates and amount, change monthly amount or due date, convert to Direct Debit (the IRS equivalent of autopay), change the bank account, or reinstate after default. Per IRS page (Mar 2026 update): long-term plan via Direct Debit $29 setup fee online (waived for low income); non-direct-debit monthly plan $69 online ($43 low income, may be reimbursed); short-term plan no setup fee. Stopping Direct Debit is done by revising the plan in the same tool or calling. Long-term plan paper option: Form 9465 / Form 433-H.

entries.name: IRS - Quarterly estimated tax payments (Form 1040-ES)
entries.service_area_detail: Retirees with pension/IRA/investment/Social Security income not fully covered by withholding; due Apr 15, Jun 15, Sep 15, Jan 15
entries.payment_processor: IRS Direct Pay / Online Account / EFTPS (free); Pay1040 and ACI Payments for cards
entries.senior_programs: Alternative to quarterly bills: request federal withholding from Social Security (Form W-4V) or pensions/IRA distributions; Tax Withholding Estimator.
entries.notes: Estimated payments can be scheduled in advance: Online Account and Direct Pay allow scheduling up to 365 days ahead; EFTPS allows scheduling up to 365 days in advance and changing/canceling scheduled payments (effectively autopay for all four quarters). Online Account payment history confirms each quarterly payment posted.

entries.name: Utah State Tax Commission (individual income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: Utah individual income tax balances, prepayments, payment agreements; Circuit Breaker renter/homeowner credit (seniors 66+ via county/tax commission)
entries.payment_processor: Taxpayer Access Point (TAP, state) - e-check; credit/debit via GovPay (3% fee); PayPal cryptocurrency option
entries.senior_programs: Homeowner's/Renter's Relief (circuit breaker; renters file TC-90CB with the Tax Commission via TAP, homeowners TC-90H with county; low-income abatement TC-90L): https://tax.utah.gov/relief/homeowner-renter-relief/
entries.notes: TAP: file and pay, view balances and correspondence, and schedule payments. Make a payment without login: https://tap.tax.utah.gov/TaxExpress/_/?Link=MakeAPayment . Payment agreements via TAP, phone 801-297-7703, or Form TC-804 (considered after return processed). Taxpayer Advocate: https://tax.utah.gov/taxpayer-advocate/ .

entries.name: Virginia Tax (Virginia Department of Taxation) - individual income tax
entries.service_area_detail: Virginia individual income tax bills (notices of assessment), 760ES estimated payments, payment plans
entries.phone_pay_by_phone: 804-440-5100 (Teleplan automated, 24 hrs, individual accounts); Paymentus card line 1-833-339-1307
entries.payment_processor: Virginia Tax online (free bank debit; schedule payment date) and QuickPay (https://quickpay.tax.virginia.gov/VTOL/QuickpayLogin.seam); Paymentus for credit/debit cards (fee)
entries.senior_programs: Age deduction for taxpayers 65+ (calculator): https://www.tax.virginia.gov/age-deduction-calculator ; local real estate tax relief for elderly is run by each city/county.
entries.notes: Individual payment options page covers bank debit, Paymentus card, check with 760-PMT voucher. Estimated payments: https://www.tax.virginia.gov/individual-estimated-tax-payments (760ES eForm allows choosing payment date). Payment plans: "set up automatic payments" (autopay); existing plan management and cancellation rules: https://www.tax.virginia.gov/existing-payment-plans . Credit card page: https://www.tax.virginia.gov/credit-card-payments . Taxpayer Rights Advocate: https://www.tax.virginia.gov/taxpayer-rights-advocate-office . Real estate/personal property tax is local (county/city treasurer).

entries.name: Virgin Islands Bureau of Internal Revenue (VIBIR) - income tax
entries.parent_company: Government of the U.S. Virgin Islands
entries.service_area_detail: USVI individual income tax (mirror code; bona fide residents file with VIBIR instead of the IRS), gross receipts and excise tax.
entries.payment_processor: USVI Taxpayer Portal (income-tax.bir.vi.gov; login with user ID, password and texted/emailed PIN)
entries.notes: Offices: 6115 Estate Smith Bay Ste 225, St. Thomas 00802; 4008 Estate Diamond Plot 7-B, Christiansted, St. Croix 00820-4421. The portal login page does not publicly describe which payment methods it takes. Other portals: gross receipts https://gross-receipts.bir.vi.gov/ , excise https://excise.bir.vi.gov/ . www.bir.vi.gov (with www) failed DNS for automated fetch; bir.vi.gov works. Reviewer 2026-09-30: bir.vi.gov homepage re-read; it links Income Tax Online, Gross Receipts Online and Pay Excise Tax logins, office locations (Red Hook, Crown Bay, Estate Diamond) and the phone numbers above.

entries.name: Vermont Department of Taxes (personal income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: Vermont personal income tax balances, estimated payments, payment plans; Property Tax Credit / Homestead Declaration
entries.payment_processor: myVTax (state) - e-check/ACH debit; card via third-party
entries.senior_programs: Property Tax Credit (income-based, file with Homestead Declaration HS-122): https://tax.vermont.gov/property/tax-credit ; myVTax guide: https://tax.vermont.gov/myvtax/homestead-declaration-property-tax-credit ; Taxpayer Advocate: https://tax.vermont.gov/help-and-resources/taxpayer-advocate
entries.notes: Schedule payment for any day up to the due date (Paying Tax Owed page). How to Make a Payment in myVTax: https://tax.vermont.gov/myvtax/make-payment - cancel a payment before 4:00 p.m. ET on business days. Payment options overview: https://tax.vermont.gov/help/payment-options .

entries.name: Washington Department of Revenue (no personal income tax; capital gains excise tax)
entries.service_area_detail: No wage/personal income tax. Capital gains excise tax on high long-term gains; some seniors with large asset sales may owe. Senior property tax exemption/deferral is administered by county assessors/treasurers.
entries.senior_programs: Property tax exemption (age 61+, disabled, or 80%+ disabled veterans; income-based) and deferral (60+) programs, applied through county assessor: https://dor.wa.gov/taxes-rates/property-tax/property-tax-exemptions-and-deferrals
entries.notes: Included because WA has no personal income tax but does levy a capital gains excise tax: https://dor.wa.gov/taxes-rates/other-taxes/capital-gains-tax . Self-service payment plans with recurring scheduled withdrawals; bank changes at least 2 business days before scheduled payment. Senior Citizen/Disabled property tax exemption is applied for with the county assessor.

entries.name: Wisconsin Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: Wisconsin individual income tax balances, Form 1-ES estimated payments, payment plans; Homestead Credit (low-income seniors/renters)
entries.mail_payment_address: Use mailing address on the voucher (Customer Service Bureau: PO Box 8949, Madison, WI 53708-8949)
entries.payment_processor: Wisconsin DOR quickpay (https://tap.revenue.wi.gov/pay) - direct debit free; credit card, Apple Pay, PayPal (convenience fees)
entries.senior_programs: Homestead Credit: https://www.revenue.wi.gov/Pages/Individuals/homestead.aspx
entries.notes: My Tax Account (MTA) lets individuals view mail, schedule and cancel estimated payments, and more (Pay page). Estimated payment voucher 1-ES: https://www.revenue.wi.gov/Pages/OnlineServices/voucher-1es.aspx . Using MTA for personal use FAQ: https://www.revenue.wi.gov/Pages/FAQS/mta-personal.aspx . Payment plan request form A-771. Review 2: Pay page (fetched) confirms My Tax Account can schedule and cancel estimated payments.

entries.name: West Virginia State Tax Department (personal income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: WV personal income tax balances, estimated payments, payment plans; Senior Citizens Tax Credit (property tax) and Social Security modification
entries.payment_processor: MyTaxes (state) - ACH debit ("Pay Personal Income Tax" link); credit cards via third-party (see Credit Card Payments page)
entries.senior_programs: Senior Citizens Tax Credit: https://tax.wv.gov/Individuals/SeniorCitizens/Pages/SeniorCitizensTaxCredit.aspx ; Social Security modification: https://tax.wv.gov/Individuals/SeniorCitizens/Pages/SeniorCitizenSocialSecurityModification.aspx ; Taxpayer Advocate: https://tax.wv.gov/TaxpayerAdvocate/Pages/TaxpayerAdvocate.aspx
entries.notes: Payment plans: one-time and recurring payments via MyTaxes; 12-month plan with recurring payments avoids a lien; "Manage Recurring Payments" link on the account controls automatic installment payments (setup/cancel). $15 fee for returned electronic payments. Credit card page: https://tax.wv.gov/Individuals/ElectronicFiling/PaymentOptions/Pages/IndividualsCreditCardPayments.aspx .

entries.name: Wyoming Department of Revenue (no personal income tax)
entries.service_area_detail: No personal income tax
entries.phone_customer_service: 307-777-7320 (Property Tax Refund Program, Department of Revenue)
entries.senior_programs: Wyoming Property Tax Refund Program (income/asset-based refund of property tax on primary residence; online application at https://wptrs.wyo.gov/): https://revenue.wyo.gov/property-tax-refund-program
entries.notes: No state personal income tax. Property tax is billed by county treasurers; Wyoming property tax refund program for residents is administered by DOR (page not fetched this pass). Review 2: Property tax relief page (fetched) lists the Property Tax Refund Program (annual application, online at wptrs.wyo.gov or through the county treasurer; DOR 307-777-7320) and county property tax deferral.
